nodes.label: Allow Tearing (DXGI VRR)
nodes.rationale: Exclusive Fullscreen cannot present with DXGI_PRESENT_ALLOW_TEARING; G-Sync/FreeSync in the driver still applies in that mode. The Present path ignores a live toggle until the swapchain is recreated with the creation flag.

nodes.label: Force Enable HDR
nodes.rationale: Force enable and the HDR master switch apply on the next launch because swapchain replace is one-shot.

nodes.label: LBuffer Native-Res Grade
nodes.rationale: Without DLSS, Anomaly skips Keen SDR and grades native-res LBuffer into a dest DrawGameScene can copy, using fp16 when Keen's 8-bit custom texture would clip BT.2390 values above 1.

nodes.label: Flip-Model scRGB Swapchain
nodes.rationale: The master HDR checkbox needs a restart because swapchain replace is one-shot and is not undone at runtime.

nodes.label: Anomaly Owns Shared Rendering Gaps
nodes.rationale: When this pack invents lighting, IsolatedMix energy, or march LOD that the next Anomaly shader will also need, file it on Anomaly rather than leaving a pack-private workaround.

nodes.label: Rich HUD Deferred Config Save
nodes.rationale: Rich HUD sliders must not serialize or write config on every tick; ControlChanged can fire on every mouse move and a per-tick XmlSerializer/File.CreateText stalls work that later shows up as a GPU reset.
